title: Digital Tube Pre Inflator - ICON PI C
description: Tube inflation system with timer for tyre manufacturing units.
subtitle: Digital Tube Pre Inflator
fullDescription: Tube inflation system with timer for tyre manufacturing units. Features timer with digital display range from 1 sec to 99 min, inflates the tube with vacuum pressure, tower lamp with buzzer for process and end of cycle indication, and emergency stop protection.
features: Timer with digital display range from 1 sec to 99 min
Timer value remains at timing range even at power on-off cycle
Audible and visual end of the cycle signal indicators
Tower lamp with buzzer for process and end of cycle indication
Soft touch tactile keys for time setting
Inflates the tube with vacuum pressure
Pressure regulator with pressure gauge for input air pressure setting
Pedal switch option for start of operation

specifications.inputAirHose: 10mm x 10mtrs PU Hose with suitable fittings
specifications.inputFilter: 1/2 x 5 micron air filter with regulator suitable fittings
specifications.outputAirHose: 10mm x 10mtrs PU Hose with clip-on connector
specifications.workingPressureRange: 0 to 1000 water column (mm H2O) - working even at vacuum pressure
specifications.keypad: Membrane Keypad suitable for outdoor application
specifications.display: 4 Digit 7 Segment LCD with Automatic LED backlight ON & OFF
specifications.dimensions: Dimension varies depends on customer requirement
specifications.note: External storage tank is must and size may vary depends upon customer requirement
